messages:
emily: Heads-up: tiny product demo next Tues 11am PT. Need a crisp reg page, Zoom + backup ingest, and a fast replay workflow. Key outputs: three short social clips (45-60s) and one 6m product highlight for SDRs.
raj: Ill spin up the form. Do we want separate CTAs for social clip access vs full replay, or one CTA + post-event segmentation?
mike: One CTA on the page (join live) + a checkbox for "send short clips". That checkbox sets hubspot property send_clips=true so we can route.
sophie: Zoom setup: cloud recording (speaker + gallery), enable separate audio channels, auto-transcript, and enable live stream RTMP to backup ingest. Also set recording to save both speaker view and gallery.
raj: Reg page details: local timezone display, hidden fields: utm_medium=organic, campaign=launch_micro_demo, and demo_variant. Will add checkbox send_clips and replay_opt_in (checked).
zara: Clip priority: 1) 0:00-0:45 benchmark + callout (LinkedIn), 2) 0:45-1:30 cost/latency before/after (X), 3) 1:30-2:15 UX demo (IG/YT short). Owner: @zara edit notes, @raj will drop timestamps in recording comments.
ops-bot: Backup ingest configured: RTMP -> ingest.recorder.redwood/launch_demo_3122 (placeholder).
mike: Email cadence: T+5m to registrants = replay link + CTA to watch 45s clip; T+18h to attendees = 6m highlight tailored to attendees; T+72h to no-shows = benchmark PDF + invite to on-demand office hours.
emily: HubSpot lists we need: attendees, registrants_no_show, registrants_watched_clip. raj ensure form records watched_clip boolean (updated via streaming analytics).
sophie: Rehearsal: Mon 30m prior. Checklist: co-hosts (emily + sophie), disable virtual backgrounds for main speaker, verify separate audio tracks, confirm RTMP fallback functioning, assign chat monitor.
raj: Drive path for recordings/edits: /Marketing/Events/MicroDemo_3122/. Ill create folders: raw_recordings, clip_cuts, masters, asset_tags.csv.
zara: Edit process: raj tags cloud recording with timestamps like "00:00:12 - benchmark stat". Ill create a sheet with clip notes + caption text for socials.
mike: Draft email subject options: A) "Quick demo: how we shaved inference cost in minutes" B) "Watch a 45s highlight from our live demo". Will post drafts in drive by EOD.
emily: Ownership recap: reg page = raj, zoom + rehearsal = sophie, messaging + emails = mike, clip edits = zara, event lead = emily. React with :white_check_mark: when set.
raj: Set. :white_check_mark:
sophie: Set, added rehearsal calendar entry. :white_check_mark:
mike: On it, will upload copy. :white_check_mark:
zara: Starting edit template now. :white_check_mark:
emily: Great team. If anything breaks, ping ops-bot and drop notes here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
file_notes: Micro demo greenroom playbook thread: registration fields, Zoom + RTMP fallback, clip priorities and post-event send schedule.
